key_provisions_or_claims: Page promotes EU ethical guidelines for educators on AI and data use in teaching and learning.
Guidelines cover ethical principles, requirements and new competences needed.
Notes lack of detailed impact assessments and potential ethical concerns of AI in education.
Encourages teachers to use the guidelines and share them with colleagues and parents.
annotation.summary_en: EU Learning Corner web page (Hungarian) presenting the European Commission's ethical guidelines for educators on using AI and data in teaching and learning, with a download link. It highlights opportunities, missing impact assessments and ethical concerns. The guidelines themselves are not reproduced.
annotation.title_clean: Etikai iránymutatások oktatók számára a mesterséges intelligencia (MI) és az adatok oktatási és tanulási célú felhasználásáról
annotation.title_en: Ethical guidelines for educators on the use of artificial intelligence (AI) and data in teaching and learning
